item.title: Hello 1.0.6
item.description:
Hello 1.0.6

  • Hello Type: suggestions while you type, in any app. Turn it on in the new Typing page (⌘3). Hello quietly learns your own words and phrases as you type and from your dictations; when it is confident about the next word it shows it in grey next to the cursor. Press Tab to accept, or keep typing to ignore it.
  • A fresh install suggests nothing at first: Hello only suggests what it has seen you write.
  • Everything stays on your Mac. Password fields and secure keyboard entry are never read or learned, and "Forget everything" moves what Hello learned to the Trash.
  • Keyboard shortcuts moved: Typing is ⌘3, Appearance to Notetaker are ⌘4 to ⌘9; History is in the View menu.
